title: The Providence of God
definition: The providence of God is His ongoing care, guidance, and governance of all things according to His wisdom and purposes.
summary: God is not distant from His creation. He upholds, directs, provides, restrains, and works through ordinary and extraordinary means.
christFocus: God's providence is seen throughout Christ's life, death, and resurrection. What appeared to be defeat became the means of redemption.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is not distant from His creation. He upholds, directs, provides, restrains, and works through ordinary and extraordinary means.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
